table_z_note: Height (robot base frame, gripper_end origin) at which the gripper touched the board in the step-c attempt on 2026-11-21 (corners A/B: -75/-66 mm). The board lies on a box next to the robot table, so it is NOT the base mounting plane. Used only for the safety floor and to aim the camera; the calibration itself measures the real board height.

camera_prior.note: Rough wrist-camera guess for the planner's visibility check only (camera behind the fingertips, looking along the finger direction). The calibration replaces it.

max_step_deg_note: v3.9 value (1.0 deg) was used as LeRobot max_relative_target; replaced by follower_mrt_deg in v3.9.1
follower_mrt_note: v3.9.1: LeRobot max_relative_target for the arm joints (teleop uses 5). The executor keeps its goal within lead_frac * this of the MEASURED position, so LeRobot never clamps. With 1.0 the goal could lead by only 1 deg, too little PD torque to lift elbow_flex from rest (22:29 crash log).
freeze_note: v3.9.6: feedback frozen / command not acknowledged -> torque stays on, the last target is re-sent and the feedback polled; back within freeze_ride_s -> re-sync and continue; back within freeze_giveup_s -> soft stop return; never back -> torque off (last resort). 0 = old behaviour (torque off after frozen_s)
camera_wait_note: v3.9.5: camera loss during a pose = hold + keep reading motors, wait up to frame_wait_s then retry the same pose; CameraLost after camera_lost_s (solve if >= 10 samples, else --resume). Watchdog: loud log + stack dump after watchdog_warn_s without a motor read, emergency torque off + exit after watchdog_hard_s or 2 s after STOP while blocked
auto_note: v3.9.1 automatic start: search pose search_heights_mm above the expected board point (handeye.json > taught pose > board_guess_mm), board centre from the wrist image (ray to the plane table_z_mm), then aim_height_mm above it; estimates must agree within auto_tol_mm.
min_samples_after_abort_note: v3.9.2: after an abort (comm loss, stuck joint, STOP) the sweep is solved if at least this many good samples exist; applied automatically only if GOOD
